text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That was so fun~♪

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"WOOOOOOOOO!!
Fine Motiooooon!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Damn, goosebumps!
Now I totally wanna run too...!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Racing must be so much fun.
Must be nice, I wanna be an Umamusume too~!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wooww... Fufu♪
Everyone has such lovely smiles. And―

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, what a beautiful autumn sky.
Racing truly is so wonderful...♪

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
"—And that concludes our broadcast of
a thrilling Shuka Sho~!
We'll see you at the next race!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I knew it,
you really are different from the rest.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...To find out,
I've got no choice but to go, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the Shuka Sho behind her, Fine Motion was set to hold
a press conference to respond to the ever-increasing attention.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
First of all, congratulations on the Shuka Sho.
That was a magnificent run!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: How was it? How do you feel right now...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I feel so refreshed.
Thanks to everyone's high hopes for me,
I was able to run with pure joy.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Those feelings really came through just by watching your race... It was truly wonderful! So, um...

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure everyone is wondering
about Fine Motion-san's next race.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Our next race, is it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She glances over, and I nod back.
Naturally, it has to be THAT race—our ultimate goal!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
We
are aiming for the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Looking at track records, that's definitely the spot!
Still, interesting... Going after the "Queen" title, are we?!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, did you catch the broadcast?
They said Fine Motion's going for the Queen Elizabeth II Cup next!"

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
I saw it! Man~,
it'd be totally nuts if she became the Queen!
I definitely gotta see that in person~!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, the press conference was a huge success.
Everyone is expecting so much from us!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unlike the Classic races, the Queen Elizabeth II Cup features top-tier Senior class contenders.
As we were discussing how to properly get her into peak condition...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hold on just a second~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The one who appeared was... the ferocious Umamusume bearing "Princess" in her name, Kawakami Princess.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I saw your press conference just now!
Fine-san, you're entering the Queen Elizabeth II Cup?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's true, but...?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "In that case! My mind is made up! —I will fight you!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Me too! I shall be running
in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup as well~~!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: B-But, but...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
As someone connected to royalty,
I refuse to yield the Queen's throne to anyone!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Fine-san!
This is a declaration of war~~~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Between you, who carry royal blood, and me, who bears the name of princess!
Let us settle this in an all-out clash!

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh~...!
A rival has appeared for Fine Motion!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
In soccer terms, is that like...
the "Der Kaiser" and the "Superstar"!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I have no idea who they are, but they must be!
This is getting so intensely exciting~~!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...! Wonderful!
How should I respond?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It seems there is no need for me to tell you.
After all, you already have the eyes of someone
who says, "Bring it on!"

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text: Ooooooh~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day's racing headlines were obvious...
"Queen Elizabeth II Cup Princess Showdown?!"
...Peak excitement was guaranteed!
